name: Nothing Taken Is Ever Truly Gone

description.value: Once per day, when a creature or object claimed by you (marked by Already Mine, Cult Sign, or a similar effect) is destroyed, killed, or taken from you by any means, you may call it back. Within 1 minute it returns to your side exactly as it was the moment before — restored to full Hit Points if it was a creature that died, or whole again if it was an object destroyed. The Claimant has never once truly let go of anything.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, when a claimed creature/object is destroyed/killed/taken, call it back within 1 minute fully restored" -- no revert/undo-destruction rule-element precedent found in pf2e-source within this pass's research budget.
